{"headline": "A short practice update from Whitfield Wealth Partners", "body": "As we begin the winter season, we want to share a brief update on the practice.

Whitfield Wealth Partners serves 12 client households. Our quarterly review windows fall in the first two weeks of January, April, July, and October, and we look forward to speaking with you during those periods.

For transparency on costs, the total market ETF used in client accounts carries a 0.03% annual expense ratio.

Whitfield Wealth Partners is a registered investment adviser in the United States. Registration does not imply a certain level of skill or training. Please reach out with any questions.", "disclosures": ["D-03", "D-04"]}
